answer.reason: The verses tell several distinct events of Lot's life beyond the summary: his parting from Abram, his capture and rescue, and his escape from Sodom's destruction.

clauses.english: chose the plain of Jordan and separated from Abram
clauses.quote: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan

clauses.english: was taken captive with his goods and brought back by Abram
clauses.quote: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods

clauses.english: was led out of Sodom by the angels before the LORD destroyed the city
clauses.quote: God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow

doubts: GEN 19:30-38 (the cave and his daughters' sons Moab and Ammon) left out as not among the chief deeds of the line; DEU 2 and PSA 83 mention only the 'children of Lot' as his descendants.
